title: Estimator work bound
statement: Let $n,m\in\mathbb N$, let $J$ be a finite set of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates, and let $S\subseteq J$. The work component of the restricted Fourier weight estimator cost is at most $8(m+1)(n+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: finite coordinate set J within the n coordinates
